name: ATMOSPHERE OS — REVIEW PHOTO WEBP EDITION
changes: Converts every newly submitted review photo to WebP in the browser before upload
Limits the width to 1600 px and uses 0.82 WebP quality with high-quality canvas resampling
Accepts source JPG, PNG or WebP files up to 25 MB while keeping the uploaded WebP under the existing 10 MB server limit
Shows a clear optimization state while the customer submits a review and preserves graceful photo-specific errors
Updates all 18 product review forms to explain the automatic WebP optimization
Preserves the complete existing Journal order from 01 through 21 without rewriting or removing any article
Adds Chapter V with five high-intent editorial comparisons numbered 22 through 26
Adds Ukrainian versus imported diffuser, diffuser versus candle, premium versus mass market, soft-scent selection and premium gift guides
Introduces direct-answer blocks, decision comparisons, responsive tables, product direction cards and visible FAQ sections
Adds Article, BreadcrumbList and FAQPage structured data to every new guide
Adds five optimized 1672 × 941 WebP editorial images produced from VA HOME-owned site imagery
Updates Journal ItemList schema to 26 entries and adds every new guide and image to the sitemaps
Keeps commercial routes contextual: Discovery Set, Scent Profile or a specific guide instead of repeating one generic CTA
Changes the full Discovery Set credit to 250 UAH on one full-size fragrance or 450 UAH on two or more
Keeps the 6-scent Discovery Credit at 150 UAH on one full-size fragrance
Adds tier-aware validation to checkout, order creation and the atomic database redemption guard
Shows the current Discovery Credit tier dynamically when cart quantities change
Adds a discreet Welcome Credit 100 UAH note to the Personal Scent Profile introduction
Hides the promo-code jump whenever no active credit exists
Explains that Welcome Credit is unavailable after a previous full-size purchase instead of opening an empty section
Keeps the 100 UAH Welcome Credit restricted to genuinely new full-size customers
Shortens the Discovery and Welcome Credit next-step headline for faster scanning
Turns the promo-code jump into a clear secondary action with equal visual affordance
Compacts the Atmosphere introduction and improves desktop/mobile hierarchy
Adds Welcome Credit: personal 100 UAH code for seven days after a signed-in new customer completes Personal Scent Profile
Restricts Welcome Credit to the first full-size fragrance purchase and prevents stacking through the single-code checkout flow
Shows the Welcome Credit in the Atmosphere account hub and guides signed-out test users to activate it in their account
Rewords the Discovery Credit hero as an amount credited to the customer account and links directly to the promo code below
Expands the saved Room Ritual in the account with placement, care, correction and 24–48 hour reassessment guidance
Guides the signed-in customer with one contextual Next Step in the Atmosphere hub
Moves Current Scent from order history into the Atmosphere hub
Hides Discovery Credit and Private Preview surfaces when they are not active
Adds an active-order count beside the Orders tab and preserves the Favorites count
Clarifies Scent Profile, Room Ritual, Discovery Credit and Private Preview in plain Ukrainian
Improves action labels and immediate feedback after wishlist, repeat and Room Ritual actions
Replaces native Room Ritual dropdowns and number spinners with premium accessible controls
Displays the saved Room Ritual inside the customer Atmosphere hub with restore and delete actions
Clarifies Discovery Credit: 150 UAH after the 6-scent set; 250 UAH on one or 450 UAH on two full-size fragrances after the 18-scent set
Adds one-click Repeat Atmosphere actions in the customer account
Persists Personal Scent Profile locally and in Supabase with match percentages
Adds Discovery Credit with personal codes after completed Discovery Set orders and 60-day validity
Adds Room Ritual recommendations by room, area, presence and bottle placement
Adds authenticated Private Preview infrastructure for releases 48 hours early
Keeps promo use atomic through the production order redemption guard
